name: Veriserum (ETH Zurich, MICCAI 2025)
what: about 110,000 dual-plane fluoroscopic images of knee implant phantoms with registered poses, 200 with manual registration (ETH Research Collection doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000701146)
licence: In Copyright - Non-Commercial Use Permitted (as the ETH Research Collection record's rights line reads, read 2026-10-22)
how_to_get: Open https://movement.ethz.ch/data-repository/veriserum.html and the ETH Research Collection record doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000701146; read the licence and the file list.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE for each file address the record gives.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; freely accessible per the authors, licence to confirm on the page; real flat-panel fluoroscopy of metal implants at scale, which the project otherwise learns only from simulation
